0022600219.text: The Raptors (5-5, sixth in the East and 3.5 games back in the Atlantic) host the Celtics (9-2, first in the East and the Atlantic), who have won four straight and are 9-1 over their last ten. Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (foot fracture), and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness) as out, while Collin Murray-Boyles (illness), Immanuel Quickley (hamstring), and Trayce Jackson-Davis (illness) are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, and Boston has no listed absences. The teams have not met yet this season, but Toronto lost 0-4 to Boston in 2025-26, including a 115-101 loss in Boston on April 5, 2026.
